expected.raw_text: Interesse an Conversational AI, Chatbots, Voicebots oder AI Agents

parsed.degree_signal: abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, AI, Engineering oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
parsed.notes:
The qualifications section has no optional heading; alternatives joined by 'oder' remain required criteria under the guide.
Conversational AI and AI Agents are nice_to_have because 'Interesse an' governs the entire list. Chatbots and Voicebots are treated as conversational-AI applications, without inferring speech recognition.
Azure AI is listed as unmapped because the taxonomy has no specific entry for that platform; Azure itself is separately explicit.
Degree fields are not labeled as candidate skills. A comparable field does not constitute an experience alternative to the degree.
Practical experience alone supplies no usable seniority signal. German is inferred solely from the German-language posting.
